tools.name: stayai_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscription contracts with status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED), next billing date, customer and dunning state. Good first call for churn and billing questions. Stay API: GET /subscriptions/.

tools.name: stayai_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by its Shopify or internal subscription id. Stay API: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

tools.name: stayai_list_customers
tools.description: List subscription customers, filtered by creation or update time. Stay API: GET /customers.

tools.name: stayai_list_orders
tools.description: List recurring orders generated from subscriptions, filtered by creation or update time. Stay API: GET /orders.

tools.name: stayai_list_billing_attempts
tools.description: List billing attempts for the store, successful and failed, with error codes and messages. Useful for payment-failure and dunning analysis. Stay API: GET /billing/attempts.

tools.name: stayai_list_catalog
tools.description: List the products in the store catalog that Stay can sell on subscription. Stay API: GET /products/catalog.

tools.name: stayai_get_catalog_product
tools.description: Get one catalog product by its Shopify product id. Stay API: GET /products/{shopifyProductId}.

tools.name: stayai_list_selling_plan_groups
tools.description: List subscription selling plan groups (the plans a shopper can pick), optionally for one product or variant. Stay API: GET /selling-plan-groups/.

tools.name: stayai_get_selling_plan_group
tools.description: Get one selling plan group by its Stay id. Stay API: GET /selling-plan-groups/{sellingPlanGroupId}.

tools.name: stayai_end_subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription. This ends future orders and cannot be undone by this server (reactivation is a separate Stay action). Pass the reasons the merchant or customer gave. Stay API: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/cancel.

tools.name: stayai_skip_line
tools.description: Skip the next delivery of one line on a subscription. A retry after a lost reply can skip a further delivery, so do not repeat it blindly. Stay API: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/lines/{lineId}/skip.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stayai_list_billing_attempts · Public sink: stayai_end_subscription, stayai_skip_line.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stayai_list_billing_attempts · Public sink: stayai_end_subscription, stayai_skip_line

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
